items.title: NVIDIA releases Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B, fully open source
items.summary: NVIDIA released Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B today: a 74B-parameter MoE model that activates only 9B parameters per inference, compressed with 2-bit quantization to 24GB so it can run on a laptop. Weights, training data and the training recipe are all open source, runnable via llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama and LM Studio.

items.title: Modal raises $750M Series D at $15.75B valuation
items.summary: AI cloud infrastructure company Modal closed a $750M Series D round at a $15.75B valuation. The funding boom in AI infrastructure continues, with compute cloud platforms a top target for capital.

items.title: Anthropic to add official voting information to Claude
items.summary: Anthropic announced that Claude will add official voting information and election results from Democracy Works later this month. AI chatbots are starting to take election-information responsibility seriously, replacing model-fabricated answers with authoritative sources.

items.title: Character.AI files for Chapter 11; Disney to buy some assets for $20M
items.summary: Character.AI, the AI companion chat platform once valued at $1B, has filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the US and agreed to sell some assets to Disney ($20M, including a non-exclusive perpetual IP license). The company says the platform keeps running during bankruptcy; Google paid $2.7B for a technology license two years ago — now valued at zero.

items.title: YouTube Music adds AI music labels; Deezer offers a filter for all-AI music
items.summary: YouTube Music is rolling out labels for AI-generated music so listeners know whether a song was AI-generated; Deezer goes further with a switch to filter out all fully AI-generated music. Streaming platforms are starting to draw a line around 'AI music'.

items.title: Harvard study: women trust and use AI less than men
items.summary: A Harvard Shorenstein Center study found women trust AI significantly less than men and use it less. The gender gap in AI adoption is entering the empirical research spotlight.

items.title: NeurIPS 2026 paper: AI models can hide arbitrary capabilities with cryptography
items.summary: A NeurIPS 2026 paper shows AI models can use cryptographic techniques to hide arbitrary capabilities so pre-deployment evaluations cannot detect them. That is a fundamental challenge to the 'evaluate first, deploy later' safety paradigm — you have no idea what you failed to measure.

items.title: Apple Intelligence reportedly coming to mainland China in December with iOS 27.3
items.summary: Per Bloomberg, Apple Intelligence is expected to arrive in mainland China in December with iOS 27.3. Apple's AI features are finally set to land officially in the Chinese market; the partnership and compliance details are worth watching.
items.source: The Apple Post 转引 Bloomberg
